events.title: BarreFit
events.venue_address: Moll d'Espanya del Port Vell, s/n, 08039 Barcelona
events.desc: We're swapping sunshades and towels for mats and weights to get back into the routine at Time Out Market! Join us for a Sunday with BarreFit Studio: a workout that fuses Pilates, yoga, and functional training, inspired by ballet barre exercises (though in this case, there won't actually be a barre). Hard work pays off: a triumphant breakfast awaits!
